features.description: Package metadata exposes the sherlock bin and script with all Ink/React dependencies and JSX enabled.
Executable shim and static TUI shell files exist.
Token, duration, and URL formatting obey the planned boundaries.
Configuration defaults include a configurable Brewed verb and non-empty working-word list.
Static shell renders a banner, composer, and submitted-text notice.
Non-TTY startup fails with an interactive-terminal explanation.
The scaffold typechecks.
The TTY shell visibly uses the Andera theme and exits cleanly on Ctrl+C.
Session state and reducer append user tasks and notices while preserving idle mode.
Finalized transcript entries persist through subsequent submissions.
/help and unknown slash commands render transcript notices.
/exit exits through Ink's application lifecycle.
The session-store and transcript increment typecheck.
Terminal scrollback stays readable while the composer remains anchored.
Live-region and status-line components exist.
Streaming text finalizes at tool batches and turn boundaries.
Pending tool lines finalize on execution end and dangling lines settle as retried.
Token estimates grow in-turn and snap to settled usage at turn end.
Status metadata renders compact tokens and elapsed time while working words cycle without immediate repeats.
Completion rendering uses the configured verb.
The canned demo terminates with the planned persistent completion line.
The live-region increment typechecks.
Demo streaming and animation are restrained and free of visible layout shift.
RunSession exists and re-emits all four ordered model progress events.
RunSession preserves usage totals and distinguishes budget exhaustion from normal completion.
Completed runs expose final text and run-directory paths to the transcript.
Task submission invokes RunSession and disables the composer until completion.
One persistent Chrome instance is shared across runs and closed at teardown.
The real-run bridge increment typechecks.
A real investigation streams and produces the displayed artifact and manifest on disk.
Cancelling during a model stream emits a cancelled outcome.
Cancelling during a tool batch lets the batch settle before cancellation completes.
Cancellation transitions running through cancelling back to idle and persists interruption metrics.
Non-abort run failures become recoverable transcript errors.
Esc cancels only while running and the composer is restored afterward.
A cancelled run retains a finalized manifest and omits metrics.json.
The cancellation increment typechecks.
Real-run cancellation is responsive and immediately permits the next task.
Semantic and tracing modules exist.
All ten tools map to compact semantic activity or evidence lines.
Semantic derivation handles truncation, URL shortening, and evidence classification.
Tracing emits validated inputs and execution success or error while capturing runDir.
TUI tracing delegates to the existing Langfuse tracing implementation.
Name-only pending activity upgrades in place and evidence retains source URLs.
Raw input and result detail is hidden by default and rendered in verbose mode.
The semantic-activity increment typechecks.
A real transcript is visually skimmable from navigation through conclusion.
Runs-list component and test surfaces exist.
Run scanning orders newest first and classifies complete, unfinished, and stopped runs correctly.
Cancelled runs are shown as stopped and never labeled crashed.
The run list supports windowed navigation, selection, and Esc close.
Run summaries show task, timing, tokens, artifact sizes, and SHA-256 prefixes.
/runs routes into the overlay and selection appends an inline transcript summary.
The past-run browser increment typechecks.
Long real run histories remain visually navigable and summaries remain legible.
Eval menu and eval-session bridge modules exist.
Task discovery includes only eval directories containing task.json.
Trials run sequentially and emit ordered headers and assertion verdicts.
Eval reports use formatReport and persist through writeResults.
Esc cancels the current eval trial and skips the remainder.
The eval menu supports checkbox multi-select and validates a positive-integer k with default 3.
/evals enters the menu and trial progress reuses the live transcript pipeline.
The eval workflow increment typechecks.
A real k=2 eval streams live verdicts and writes a CLI-equivalent report.
Mid-stream failures append errors, recover idle mode, and relaunch a dead browser on next submit.
Missing-key, non-TTY, double-Esc, and Ctrl+C preflight/exit paths are covered.
Full scripted-run snapshots lock the rendering contract at normal and narrow widths.
README documents Sherlock launch modes, slash commands, and Esc cancellation.
The full repository test suite passes.
The finished implementation typechecks.
Sherlock leaves all agent-core directories unchanged relative to main.
Real-run motion, resize behavior, browser recovery, and R1-R12 glanceability pass human acceptance.
